title: Kuamasi language
extract: Kuamasi is a Loloish language of Heqing County, Yunnan, China. They are known by the Kua-nsi as. The Kuamasi are found in Matang 麻塘, Songping Village 松坪村, Liuhe Township 六合乡, Heqing County. A Loloish language spoken in Daying Village 大营村, Songgui Town 松桂镇 is also likely closely related to Kuamasi.
